eval_config_note: frozen_eval.score_checkpoint hardcodes StereoNetConfig() (shift=none), which would evaluate ARM S weights through a different forward graph than trained. Faithful scores use a line-for-line mirror of score_checkpoint with StereoNetConfig(cost_volume_shift=right); dataset split, GT scale, metrics, and contract guard are imported unmodified from phase1.harness.frozen_eval. The literal-harness (shift=none) numbers are stored alongside as frozen_eval_{best,final}_shift-none.json and are bit-identical (see mechanism).
frozen_variables: masked smooth-L1 beta=1.0, valid gt>0 and gt<176
split hailo_calib 160 train / hailo_val 40 eval, overlap 0
hypothesis: Restoring an actual disparity search in the cost volume (shift the RIGHT features right by k so cost_k(x) = left(x) - right(x - k), LEFT-frame indexed) gives the aggregation network genuine per-candidate matching evidence, reducing frozen-contract EPE by at least 1.0 px versus ARM K.

literal_harness_shift_none.note: bit-identical to faithful scores on all 40 scenes (see mechanism)

mechanism: Stage dump of the trained best-val weights: cost volumes differ by shift (none mean 10.65 vs right mean 21.97 on probe input) but aggregated_cost explodes to ~1e6 scale, soft-argmin saturates, disparity_initial is exactly 11.0 everywhere (std 0.0); the refinement then predicts from the left image plus a constant. Outputs are bit-identical under either shift on all 40 val scenes, so the stereo path contributes nothing and the model is a monocular-from-constant predictor operating from a worse constant (11.0) than ARM K's uniform-5.5.
variable: cost_volume_shift none -> right only: RIGHT features shifted right by k (F.pad(x,(k,0))[..., :width]), cost = left - shifted_right; modes none and left byte-identical in behaviour; StereoNetConfig default stays none
